units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 90:5">Midr. Till. to Ps. XC</cite> <he>ליטול ד׳</he> to ask a privilege.
Ib. שתתן לי ד׳, v. מֶרֶד I.—Esp. merchant’s license.

senses.gloss: צפור ד׳ a free bird, living in the house as well as in the field.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 14:1">Neg. XIV, 1</cite> <he>שתי ציפרי ד׳</he> (corresp. to <he>חיות</he>, <cite ref="Leviticus 14:4">Lev. XIV, 4</cite>); <cite ref="Tosefta Nazir 6:1">Tosef. Naz. VI, 1</cite> <he>שני ציפרים ד׳</he>; Y. ib. VIII, 57ᵃ bot.
<cite ref="Tosefta Negaim 8:3">Tosef. Neg. VIII, 3</cite> <he>שתי ציפרין ד׳ ואלו וכ׳</he> two free birds which means such as are around in the city.

Neg. XIV, 5 נמצאת שלא ד׳ it is discovered that it is not a free bird; Tosef. ib. VIII, 7 [read:] ונמצאת שנייה שלא ד׳ (v. R. S. to Neg. l. c.).—[Y. Snh. X, 28ᵃ top כד׳ נאות, read: כדּוּר בנות like the jewel of girls, v. דּוּרָא II.]
